verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no audit log or change history that records which user changed which ledger record and when, either per entity or across the whole ledger. The only related behavior is that editing a manual journal entry automatically posts a voiding (reversing) entry and a new entry. That preserves accounting history for one entry type, but it is an adjacent feature, not a who-changed-what-and-when audit trail.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger

citations.quote: Puzzle automatically creates a voiding (reversing) journal entry for the original and posts a new entry reflecting your changes.
